user.title: Select grid company
user.description: Effektvakt uses your grid company's capacity tiers to predict tier crossings.

sensors.title: Select sensors
sensors.description: Effektvakt needs a power sensor (instant power in W or kW) and ideally an energy sensor (cumulative kWh).

data.confirm_peak_sensor: I confirm the sensor reports instantaneous power

pricing.title: Custom capacity tiers
pricing.description: Enter your own kW thresholds and monthly prices, lowest first. Write the top tier with null as the threshold to make it unbounded: [[2, 155], [5, 250], [null, 415]]. Leave it out and Effektvakt has no idea what consumption above the highest number costs.

error.power_unit_invalid: Power sensor must have unit W or kW
error.energy_unit_invalid: Energy sensor must have unit Wh or kWh
error.peak_sensor_warning: Sensor looks like a peak/average aggregate. Pick an instant sensor or confirm.
error.kapasitetstrinn_invalid: Capacity tiers must be list of [kW, NOK] pairs sorted ascending
error.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured

init.title: Effektvakt settings
init.description: Change these once you have seen how Effektvakt behaves in your home. The fields show what is in effect now.

data.min_risiko_for_kutt: Cut from this level and up
data.vvb_power_sensor: Water heater power sensor (optional, for vvb_status and vvb_pluss_ekstra)
data.ekstra_power_sensors: Extra power sensors (heating cables, EV charger, etc)

mangler_topptrinn.title: Custom capacity tiers have no top tier
mangler_topptrinn.description: Your highest tier ends at {hoyeste_kw} kW. Effektvakt has no idea what consumption above that costs, and reports good margin no matter how high it goes. Write the top tier with null as the threshold, for example [[2, 155], [5, 250], [null, 415]], to make it unbounded. Tiers are changed by removing the configuration and adding it again.

ukjent_dso.title: Effektvakt no longer knows this grid company
ukjent_dso.description: The configuration points at the grid company «{dso}», which is not in the capacity tier table. It has been removed or renamed since you set up Effektvakt. Without capacity tiers neither risk nor cost can be computed, and the sensors stay empty. Remove the configuration and add it again with the correct grid company.
